regions.text: of prosperity and the still waters of peace. Yet, every so often
regions.explanation: From 50.16s to 57.70s (“of prosperity and the still waters of peace. Yet, every so …”), pitch range (10th–90th percentile) narrowed to 2.5 st from 7.6 st (-67%); that is 3.5× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Pitch movement is the main cue English listeners use to find the focus word of a phrase; with a flattened contour every word carries equal weight and the line sounds recited. Fix: Lift pitch on the focus word of each clause and let it fall at the end of the thought.
